subject: MAP: owners, milestones & signature gate (draft)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@tideworks.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP: owners, milestones & signature gate (draft)

Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps following our discovery + demo: I attached a working Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — TideWorks_MAP_v0.2.xlsx — with proposed milestones, owners, and a target close window. Please see highlighted rows for items we discussed.

Key proposed dates (draft):
- Target close: 2026-12-20 (contract fully executed)
- Procurement / signature deadline (internal): 2026-12-18
- Security review complete: 2026-12-10
- Integration kickoff: 2027-01-03

Dependencies we called out:
- Procurement needs SOW and SOC2 evidence for submission to budget committee
- Legal redlines could add 3–5 business days depending on scope
- Billing/CFO signoff timeline (you mentioned a budget window in mid-December)

Ask: can you confirm two things so we can finalize the MAP and lock the milestone owners?
1) Who will own procurement signoff on your side (name + email)?
2) Is the 12/20 target realistic, or do we need to move the signature runway earlier for budget committee cutoffs?

Attachments: TideWorks_MAP_v0.2.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_draft_TW.pdf (attached for procurement/legal to review).

I can update the MAP immediately once you confirm the procurement owner and preferred signature runway.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15-min call if helpful.

— Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@tideworks.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Michael Wu <procurement@tideworks.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: owners, milestones & signature gate (draft)

Marcus — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. A few notes from our side after internal check:

1) Procurement owner: Michael Wu (procurement@tideworks.com) — looping him in. He will own the contract routing.
2) Budget committee meets on 2026-12-16; to reliably make that cycle we need the legal-ready SOW on or before 2026-12-15. Practically that means the procurement signature runway should be 2026-12-15 (not 12/18).
3) Security: we will run the SOC2 checklist and expect to need 3 business days for our security team to validate the evidence you provide.

Inline comments I added to the MAP: moved the internal signature deadline to 2026-12-15 and flagged Legal review (Ben) as a blocker — can you confirm the expected turnaround on redlines?

If we can get the SOW and SOC2 evidence to Michael by 2026-12-08, I think we have a good chance of making the 12/16 committee.

Thanks,
Elena Rodriguez
Head of Platform Partnerships | TideWorks
elena@tideworks.com | +1 617 555 7822

To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP: owners, milestones & signature gate (draft)

Forwarding Elena's note and my quick recommendations so we can close the loop with TideWorks.

Summary / suggested updates to MAP (actionable):
- New target close: 2026-12-15 (to align with their budget committee)
- Procurement signature deadline: 2026-12-14 (have Michael route a final SOW by 12/08 per Elena)
- Milestone owners (proposed):
  - Integration / Technical PO: Vanessa Ortiz (redwood) — own kickoff and staging readiness
  - Security review: Marcus Lin (redwood) — coordinate SOC2 evidence and technical notes
  - Legal / Contract redlines: Ben Carter (redwood) — own SOW turnaround and comments
  - Billing & PO ops: Marcus Lin (redwood) — confirm invoicing cadence

Operational asks for Ben:
1) Can Legal commit to getting redline input back within 3 business days of receipt? If not, call out needed extension.
2) Ben — any objections to moving the signature runway earlier? We may be able to offer an onboarding credit if TideWorks signs by 12/12 to compensate for a compressed timeline (proposal needs approval).

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet once Ben confirms turnaround and pricing stance.

Vanessa Ortiz
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com

Date: 2026-12-03T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: owners, milestones & signature gate (draft) — redline & pricing

Thanks team — confirmation from Legal / Pricing side:

1) Legal turnaround: we can commit to an initial redline within 2 business days of receiving the SOW; final sign-off timeline will depend on external redlines but we will prioritize TideWorks.
2) Pricing / credit: we cannot apply a permanent list-price reduction, but we can offer a one-time onboarding credit of 5% if the contract is fully executed by 2026-12-12. If TideWorks signs between 12/13–12/15, standard pricing applies (no credit).
3) Attachments: attaching Redwood_SOW_draft_TW.pdf (redline-ready) — please confirm receipt.

Final (agreed) MAP items to lock now:
- Target close: 2026-12-15
- Procurement signature deadline (customer internal): 2026-12-14
- SOW & SOC2 evidence delivery to procurement: by 2026-12-08
- Legal initial redline: within 2 business days of SOW receipt
- Onboarding credit: 5% if sign by 2026-12-12 (otherwise none)

Marcus / Vanessa — I'll drop redlines into the attached SOW and send a DocuSign link once Elena/Michael confirm the final SOW.

Ben Carter
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
